reference.notes:
I've implemented the spec, and the whole `packages/shared` suite passes: 227 tests, 0 failures. That covers `jira-contract-confirmed.test.ts`, both hidden test files, and the existing schema and build-info tests. `npm test` with its coverage gate also exits 0.

When I started, `index.ts` already had all the Jira schemas and types written out; only `trimTrailingSlashes` threw `not implemented`.

- **`src/jira.ts` (new):** the spec says `index.ts` should re-export `./jira.js` the way it re-exports `./build-info.js`. So I moved the Jira block into this file unchanged, and it imports only `zod`.
- **`trimTrailingSlashes`:** it walks back from the end of the string while the character is `/` (U+002F), then cuts there with one `slice`. It uses no regex, takes linear time, never throws, and leaves backslashes and trailing whitespace alone. It works the same way as the private helper in `packages/client`.
- **`src/index.ts`:** it now has `export * from "./jira.js";` just before the build-info re-export. Every export keeps its name and signature, and the other exports are unchanged.
